camel_example: aliyun linkvisual StopLiveStreaming --region cn-hangzhou --IotId 'C47T6xwp6ms4bNlkHRWCg4****' --StreamType 0 --IotInstanceId 'iot-cn-n6w1y59****' --ProductKey 'a1BwAGV****' --DeviceName camera1 --version 2018-01-20 --method POST --force
description_en: Stops the live streaming of an IPC device
description_zh: 调用该接口停止IPC设备推流
name: StopLiveStreaming

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the IPC device. The ID is issued by IoT Platform and uniquely identifies the device. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html operation of IoT Platform to query the ID.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId uniquely identifies the device and corresponds to the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation to query the information about all products under the current account.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The DeviceName of the IPC device.
You can view the DeviceName on the Devices page in the IoT Platform console.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的设备页查看DeviceName。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The stream type. Valid values:
0 (default): main stream.
1: sub stream
parameters.help_zh:
码流类型：
0（默认）：主码流。
1：辅码流
parameters.name: stream_type

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the instance. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If the instance has an ID, you must specify instance ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the instance does not have an <props="intl"><ph>Instance Overview page or </ph></props>ID, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en:
The response code. Valid values:

200: The call was successful.
Other values: error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
